summary: AirTrail is a self-hosted flight-logging web app (SvelteKit + Prisma/Kysely over PostgreSQL). Users log flights (from/to airports, aircraft, airline, passengers with seat/reason, optional flight tracks) which are multi-user shared via flight_passenger rows; they also maintain visited countries, api_keys for a JSON REST API, public_share links (privacy-filtered public views), custom fields on flights/passengers, per-user preferences, and app config (oauth/integrations/map stored in app_config JSON).
